title: Yota Tsuji steps into the leading role
summary: Yota Tsuji’s ambition to lead New Japan moves from tournament promise to major championships. His ascent runs alongside the departure of the previous generation’s defining stars.

chapters.title: Tsuji wins the New Japan Cup
chapters.result: Tsuji defeats Goto to win the tournament.
chapters.context: The victory gives the returning young heavyweight a major achievement and another route toward the top championship.

chapters.title: Tsuji wins his first singles title
chapters.result: Tsuji defeats Finlay for the IWGP Global championship.
chapters.context: The tournament prospect becomes a champion by overcoming Bullet Club’s leader in the Dome.

chapters.title: Tsuji wins the double-title match
chapters.result: Tsuji defeats Takeshita to hold the World Heavyweight and Global titles.
chapters.context: On the night of Tanahashi’s retirement, Tsuji delivers a championship statement about New Japan’s next leading generation.
